text: 2.03 Filing of Application (a) Applications seeking authorisation for import/export of “restricted” goods, or for claiming benefits under the schemes in FTP or for seeking clarifications or for other purposes may be made online on https://dgft.gov.in (b) Applicants may ensure while submitting documents that documents are either in English or Hindi. Documents in regional languages may be translated into English or Hindi and the translated copy may be self-certified and submitted along with the original copy.
